blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines— National University watched without hesitation as Reinhard Jumamoy took the game-winning shot in overtime of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday. Jumamoy delivered with his signature triple to lift the Bulldogs to an 87-85 win over the University of Santo Tomas Growling Tigers at Smart Araneta Coliseum. NU coach oach Jeff Napa said he was confident in his veteran guard’s ability to deliver in the clutch., “That game-winner, I’ll give it to Reinhard. That’s his shot. Win or lose, we’ll take that shot,” said Napa in Filipino. […]... Keep on reading: UAAP: ‘Win or lose,’ NU trusts Reinhard Jumamoy to take big shots
